about:
# <c-4285F4>G</c><c-DB4437>D</c><c-F4B400>r</c><c-4285F4>i</c><c-0F9D58>v</c><c-DB4437>e</c> Backup!
**<cg>save & load</c> your data to <cy>Google Drive!</c>**

## <cj>Features:</c>
- **Backup and load your data to Google Drive!**
- **No file size limits!**
- **Supports platformer saves & editor level backups!**
- **Infinite save slots!**
- **Unique slots for each GD account!**
- **Super simple Google Sign in!**
- **Custom slot descriptions!**
- **Detailed save breakdowns!**

##### you can find the mod in the account menu in GD's settings!
---
## <co>Contact:</c>
Please report any issues on GitHub, or just contact me on one of the socials on my website. <cl>(discord/twitter preferred)</c>

---
## <cd>Special thanks:</c>
- camila314 for the [Geode URI API](<mod:camila314.geode-uri>)!
- & to [CoraBitz](<user:9549674>) for designing the size breakdown popup!!!!
changelog:
# v1.4.1
- fix windows crash
- other bub fix

# v1.4.0
- Updated to 2.2091 and Geode v6!
- Support to save & load:
    - <cy>**platformer saves**</c>
    - <cy>**editor levels auto-backups**</c>
    - <cy>**custom keybinds**</c>
    - and <cy>**game & editor options**</c>!
- **Redesigned** edit menu!
- **Slot info** menu, which shows you what data is available in that respective slot!
- Ability to load **local** save files!
- Bug fixes & improvements!

# v1.3.0
- New Edit mode! the ability to <cr>**delete**</c> saves!
-  New size information menu! shows you a complete breakdown of your save files across all your accounts!
- New drive icon option!< If you want to!
- Lots of bug fixes & optimizations!

# 1.2.1
- added the option to change the mod's button position in the account menu!

# 1.2.0
- You can now name slots! just select a slot title to edit it!
- Cleaned up errors!
- Destroyed Some Bugs.

# 1.1.0
- Added an option to load saved settings!
- Fixed Sign in issues on android devices.
- Fixed more crashes.

# 1.0.2
- Fixed crash at sign in
- Miscellaneous fixes

# 1.0.1
- Added missing description & slight error popup changes

# 1.0.0
- Initial Release! Hooray!
